summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a NI 43-101 technical report update on its Ying silver-lead-zinc-gold property in China. The report, prepared by independent qualified persons, updates mineral resource and reserve estimates, mine plans, and project economics. No transaction, corporate action, or material definitive agreement is described; the filing is a routine periodic disclosure of technical information by a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned in the context of a special situation.
